svg.desc: Liu et al. 2008 DOI 10.1021/cg701128b. Low-MW poly(vinyl pyrrolidone). MW ~30,000; AgNH route. Exact mass for the low-MW branch and internal capping geometry are not independently restated/measured. Symbolic identity, no measured molecular geometry.
